title: Teaching
text: Lecture slides with their LaTeX sources, R code and data, free to use and adapt in your own teaching. Each course site gives its license and how to cite it.

title: Teaching
text:
Courses

Lectures on Causal Panel Analysis
Six lectures on causal inference with panel data: the parametric approach, difference-in-differences, factorial difference-in-differences, two-way fixed effects, modern difference-in-differences, and synthetic control. Course site · GitHub repository


POLI 450A: Political Methodology I (Regression)
The first course in Stanford’s political science PhD methods sequence: estimation and inference, simple and multiple regression, and robust and clustered standard errors, with worksheets and short videos. Course site · GitHub repository · YouTube playlist
